d: Jeeva decides to protect Kala Devi who joins a circus company after her father's death as she inherits enormous wealth and has a threat to her life.
Durai's life takes a drastic turn after he revolts against Dharmalingam, Aalavandar and Punniyakodi, three corrupt politicians, when they try to defy the rules at a fair-price shop.
Mayandi kills inspector Gopal and his family except for Rudhra, who finds evidence against him and shows it to the police. However, when an officer begins torturing her, Rudhra vows to kill Mayandi.
